content.text: Welcome to Georgia.gov Your starting place for living, growing, and thriving in the Peach State. Services A-Z Top-Accessed Services 2026 Georgia Election Cycle Georgia's 2026 Primary is May 19, and the General Election is November 3. Make a plan to vote in both to help shape the state's future. Learn More About Voting Moving to Georgia Checklist New residents will interact with several state agencies in their first 30 days in Georgia. Get Started Under the Gold Dome The 2026 legislative session has concluded. The General Assembly adjourned Sine Die on April 2, 2026. You can continue to track the status of bills and final votes through the legislative portal. Track Legislation Tax Updates for Georgians Check your eligibility for a refund of up to $500. Georgia's motor fuel excise tax is suspended through May 19, 2026. America 250 License Plate A new standard-issue license plate is available to commemorate the 250th anniversary of the Revolutionary War. This new license plate will remain available for issuance through 2030. Choose the license plate when titling and registering your vehicle, or exchange your current plate by visiting your local tag office. Standard fees apply. Get the new design Beware of Fake Text Scams: Don't Tap; Don't Reply; Delete It! Drivers license scam: Fraudsters pretend to be from the Department of Driver Services and often threaten license suspension, fines, or credit score impacts. Read morePeach Pass scam: The FBI warns of texts attempting to scam toll road users across several states. The texts claim the recipient owes money for unpaid tolls. Read moreTax or Social Security scam: Texts claim there are issues with your account or benefits, urging you to click a link or provide information to resolve the matter. Read morePackage delivery scam: Messages claim to be from delivery services like USPS or FedEx and ask you to confirm delivery details to receive a pending package. Read more Featured Guides
